## Change

Describe the behavior changed and the reason for the change.

## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated deterministic tests.
- [ ] Ran `ruff check .`.
- [ ] Ran `pytest -q`.
- [ ] CI passes on Python 3.10, 3.11, 3.12 and 3.13.
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation.

## Data and security

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, `.env` files or personal browser data are included.
- [ ] No private OCR records, screenshots, workbooks, databases or user datasets are included.
- [ ] Raw evidence remains unchanged; derived values retain provenance.
- [ ] OCR-observed prices remain distinct from researched prices, bank offers and exchange values.
- [ ] No unapproved remote model, external MCP server or persistent automation is enabled.

## Operational impact

Describe migrations, configuration changes, side effects, rollback steps and any manual deployment action.
